cards.ex: There was an implicit trust between the soldiers who had fought together.
cards.exUz: Birgalikda jang qilgan askarlar o'rtasida so'zsiz ishonch bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga shartsiz ishonch bildirish, hech qanday shubha qilmasdan.

cards.ex: I approach new claims with a healthy skepticism until I see real evidence.
cards.exUz: Men yangi da'volarga haqiqiy dalillarni ko'rmaguncha sog'lom shubha bilan yondashaman.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishonmasdan, ozgina shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: You can place your faith in her; she's always been reliable.
cards.exUz: Siz unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u har doim ishonchli bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir to'liq ishonish, umid qilish.

cards.ex: He's a very trustworthy person; you can tell him anything.
cards.exUz: U juda ishonchli odam; unga hamma narsani ayta olasiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishonishga arziydigan, doimiy va rostgo'y bo'lgan shaxs yoki narsa.

cards.ex: The scandal caused wavering trust in the government.
cards.exUz: Janjal hukumatga bo'lgan ishonchning yo'qolishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi ishonchning kamayishi yoki yo'qolishi, shubhalanish.

cards.ex: She realized she had misplaced her trust in him when he lied.
cards.exUz: U yolg'on gapirganda, unga noto'g'ri ishonch bildirganini angladi.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz odamga yoki narsaga ishonch bildirish, xato qilish.

cards.ex: The company faced a crisis of confidence after the accounting errors were revealed.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hisobot xatoliklari oshkor bo'lgandan keyin ishonch inqirozi bilan yuzlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning ishonchini yo'qotish, katta shubha paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I have reservations about his plan; it seems too risky.
cards.exUz: Men uning rejasidan shubhalanaman; u juda xavfli ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadadir to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: You know the situation best; just trust your judgment.
cards.exUz: Siz vaziyatni eng yaxshi bilasiz; shunchaki o'z fikringizga ishoning.
cards.uzDef: O'z qarorlaringizga, fikrlaringizga ishonish, ularga asoslanish.

cards.ex: It's important to verify information before sharing it online.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumotni internetda ulashishdan oldin uni tekshirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotning to'g'riligini tasdiqlash, rostligini tekshirish.

cards.ex: His explanation smacks of lies.
cards.exUz: Uning tushuntirishi yolg'onga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir noto'g'ri yoki shubhali ekanligini ko'rsatadigan xususiyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The police are keeping tabs on the suspect.
cards.exUz: Politsiya gumondorni kuzatib turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir diqqat bilan kuzatib borish.

cards.ex: The athlete is under a cloud after failing the drug test.
cards.exUz: Sportchi giyohvandlik testidan o'ta olmaganidan keyin shubha ostida.
cards.uzDef: Shubha ostida bo'lish, obro'si buzilgan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I know it's tempting to lie, but honesty is the best policy.
cards.exUz: Yolg'on gapirish vasvasaga solishini bilaman, lekin halollik - eng yaxshi siyosat.
cards.uzDef: Har doim rost gapirish eng yaxshi yo'l ekanligini anglatuvchi maqol.

cards.ex: I can see right through him; he's not as innocent as he seems.
cards.exUz: Men uni darhol ko'raman; u ko'ringanidek begunoh emas.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yolg'onini yoki haqiqiy niyatini payqab qolish.

cards.ex: My motto is trust but verify, especially in business.
cards.exUz: Mening shiorim - ishon, lekin tekshir, ayniqsa biznesda.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir ishonish, lekin aytganlarini tekshirib ko'rish kerakligi.

cards.ex: Always double-check your work before submitting it.
cards.exUz: Har doim ishingizni topshirishdan oldin qayta tekshiring.
cards.uzDef: Xatolarni oldini olish uchun nimanidir yana bir bor tekshirish.

cards.ex: He's a closed book; nobody knows what he's really thinking.
cards.exUz: U sirli odam; hech kim uning nima o'ylayotganini bilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir yoki nimadir haqida hech narsa bilmaslik, tushunish qiyin bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: I don't trust him; he always has questionable motives.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonmayman; uning niyatlari har doim shubhali.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir qilayotgan ishlarining sabablari shubhali bo'lsa.

cards.ex: I'm just taking his word for it that he's telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Men uning haqiqatni gapirayotganiga shunchaki ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir aytganiga dalil talab qilmasdan ishonish.

cards.ex: We need to verify her credentials before hiring her.
cards.exUz: Uni ishga olishdan oldin uning diplomlarini tekshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir diplomlari, sertifikatlari to'g'ri ekanligini tekshirish.

cards.ex: If something feels wrong, trust your gut.
cards.exUz: Agar biror narsa noto'g'ri tuyulsa, ichingiz sezganiga ishoning.
cards.uzDef: Intuiziyangizga ishonish, his-tuyg'ularingizga asoslanib qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: He got the job under false pretenses; he lied about his experience.
cards.exUz: U yolg'on bahonalar bilan ishga kirdi; u o'z tajribasi haqida yolg'on gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir aldash, yolg'on ma'lumot berish orqali.

cards.ex: I agreed to the plan, but with reservations.
cards.exUz: Men rejaga rozi bo'ldim, lekin shubha bilan.
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmaslik, shubhalanib fikr bildirish yoki harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The betrayal of trust was devastating to their relationship.
cards.exUz: Ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish ularning munosabatlariga qattiq zarar yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ishonchini xiyonat qilish, pand berish.

cards.ex: We had to fly by the seat of our pants when the project went wrong.
cards.exUz: Loyiha noto'g'ri ketganda, biz tavakkal qilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.term: fly by the seat of pants
cards.uzDef: Rejasiz, tajribaga asoslanib harakat qilish, vaziyatga moslashish.

cards.ex: Their relationship is on shaky ground after the argument.
cards.exUz: Ularning munosabatlari janjaldan keyin ishonchsiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat, asos yoki dalil ishonchsiz, beqaror bo'lsa.

cards.ex: Don't worry, I've got your back if things get tough.
cards.exUz: Xavotir olmang, agar vaziyat qiyinlashsa, men sizni himoya qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qo'llab-quvvatlash, himoya qilish, yordam berish.

cards.ex: I'll give him the benefit of the doubt this time.
cards.exUz: Men unga bu safar shubhalanmaslik imkoniyatini beraman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir aybsizligiga ishonish, hatto dalillar bo'lmasa ham.

cards.ex: He's playing his cards close, so I don't know what he's planning.
cards.exUz: U o'z rejasini sir saqlaydi, shuning uchun men uning nima rejalashtirayotganini bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z rejalari, fikrlari haqida hech kimga aytmaslik, sirni saqlash.
